identity.summary: Approved logo geometry, ownership, and affiliation are unchanged. I Heart PR Tours 1.1.0 adds approved optional sand expressions outside canonical logo authority.

palette.summary: Light-guide declarations use approved source colors and measured contrast; consumers may adopt the refreshed guide presentation without changing approved palettes.

typography.summary: Existing local font sources and typography bindings remain authoritative. The shadcn registry no longer advertises an unsupported font item; follow the bundled local-font setup.

platform_assets.summary: Approved custom expressions are available to eligible consumers; existing canonical logo and platform icon roles remain unchanged.

web_react.summary: Web and React consumers using shadcn may install validated theme and UI items from direct registry endpoints; bundled local fonts remain a separate setup step.

egui.summary: The egui adapter remains at 1.0.2 with no new native API or role changes in this release.

documentation.summary: Readers using generated guidance should repin the rebuilt kit for light-guide, custom-asset, and registry installation instructions.

recovery.summary: Consumers repinning a kit must retain exact checksummed BrandBuilder 2.1.0 recovery bytes and the new immutable package identity.
